gotchas.gotcha: Commands are NOT protected by unified-creator-guard.cjs (unlike skills, agents, hooks, templates)
gotchas.why_it_happens: Commands are passive markdown prompts with no privilege escalation or integration coupling. Security threat model is equivalent to direct user input. Creator guard overhead not justified.
gotchas.trigger: Developers may expect commands to require skill-creator workflow
gotchas.solution: Commands are user-controlled, lightweight artifacts. Direct writes to .claude/commands/ are intentional and safe. No creator workflow required.
gotchas.alternatives_considered: Protect commands with creator-guard (rejected - adds complexity without proportional security benefit)
gotchas.extracted_from: Task #86 security compliance check, confirmed by Task #83 architecture design

gotchas.gotcha: While thin delegators (3-line shims) are scalable, they can become boilerplate at scale
gotchas.context: Commands System now has 16 identical 3-line delegators (only skill name varies)
gotchas.why_it_happens: Pattern is so simple that adding 1 command requires copy-paste of 3 lines
gotchas.trigger: After 10+ similar delegators are created manually, developers may want to automate
gotchas.solution: For future command additions: consider creating a command generator script or template expansion tool. But don't overcomplicate - 3-line pattern is maintainable
gotchas.future_enhancement: Optional: command-generator.cjs that takes skill name and generates command file

gotchas.gotcha: Enriched commands (/learn that integrates multiple features) can become maintenance burden if overused
gotchas.context: Only /learn enriches beyond single-skill delegation (combines context-compressor + memory protocol)
gotchas.why_it_happens: Developers may want to add convenience commands that combine multiple skills
gotchas.solution: Keep enriched commands rare. Document each enriched command's integration strategy in the catalog. Prefer orchestrating workflows via agent-level task chaining over command-level combinations.
gotchas.pattern: Enriched = single command + documentation of integration. Multi-step = agent delegation.
gotchas.extracted_from: Task #85 catalog design (1 enriched command documented as exception)
